decisions: Badge uses the actual six CVA variant classes and native22px minimum height,8/2px insets,4px gap,12/16px medium text and12px optional glyph. Native sample widths depend on wording and are never fixed. Borders are included in the22px box; content may enlarge it. The default informative span is not focusable or activatable. Only explicit caller anchor rendering gets hover/focus link rules and a real destination; variant=link alone does not invent link semantics.

Semantic token scalar values are meaningful reusable metrics, never coordinate-keyed specimen dimensions. Widths in native specimen grids remain evidence unless explicitly adopted as a domain layout constraint.
